observations.original: Compact blue-gray metal block with thin, nearly white top panel and two tiny dark front rivets. Large blank top, sharp faceted rim and dark lower mass give limited constructed detail; visible identity is salvage metal.
observations.target: More rounded and substantial blue-gray fragment with proud framed lid, two legible hexagonal fasteners, soft wide highlights and restrained orange-brown corrosion/scuff patches. Target adds plausible worn construction and volume; very bright side edge and large decorative scratches should not become literal fixed lighting or mandatory noise.
observations.globalStyle: Plant reference uses strongly readable chunky volumes, softened formed edges, controlled broad color regions, bright crown and deeper base. Visible plane separation and toy-like clarity matter more than photo-real microtexture.
observations.targetLimits: One front-facing plate target provides design vocabulary, not a camera/root/bounds authority or a literal unseen-variant blueprint. Preserve metal palette and salvage identity; do not import green/orange plant palette.
